description.content:
## Introduction
The B2MMessagingSync API supports generateC1Report, generateC4Report, getMSATSLimits,NMIDiscovery, getNMIDetail, getParticipantSystemStatus, and getMeterData endpoints.The API participant pushes their outgoing message to the e-Hub and the e-Hub pushes the message to the API recipient.The message delivery occurs synchronously where the participant sends the message to the e-Hub and AEMO immediately sends the response (such as MACKs,TACKs, or responses) in the same thread to the Participant's Gateway.
